<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/openapi/reward/getCustomerOffers"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the complete set of active offers available to a customer alongside their
current loyalty balance, tier, tier progression data, and redemption limits. Call
this endpoint at the start of a transaction or when rendering a customer's wallet
screen — the response provides everything needed to display available discounts and
loyalty status in a single call. Optionally pass the current order context in the
`order` field to enable dynamic offer eligibility evaluation against the live basket.
Use `beansExpiryAfterDays` to surface expiring points and drive redemption urgency.
